status: Experimental interoperability profile; not an audited Bulletproofs variant
encoding: Every integer is unsigned 32-byte big-endian; every tag is Keccak256(UTF8(label)); point encoding is x||y, infinity is (0,0); concatenation has no lengths except the explicit dimensions below
parametersHash: K(tag(parameters)||64||valueBase||blindingBase||g[0]||...||g[63]||h[0]||...||h[63]); use EXP-01 fixed upstream derivation; validate all 130 points, nonidentity, on curve, canonical and pairwise distinct
challenge: inputState=K(state||tag(stage)||payload); for counter=0..255 compute c=uint256(K(inputState||tag(candidate)||counter)); accept first 0<c<q; state=K(inputState||tag(accepted)||c); no modular reduction; failure to find one rejects proof and prover restarts
pointRules: C_range may be identity; A,S,T1,T2,L,R must be nonidentity; every point must have x,y
scalarRules: tauX,mu,t,a,b must each be <q; zero is allowed; challenges are all in [1,q-1]
randomness: SecureRandom rejection sampling in [0,q-1], including zero; retry whole proof on disallowed internal identity; polynomial coefficients selected by positions 1 and 2, never by blinding value
statement: For amount v, prove u=v-1 in [0,2^64-1] over C_range=C_original-valueBase; v may equal 2^64 and must not be truncated to uint64
abi: verify(bytes32 operationId,uint256 outputIndex,uint256[10] coords,uint256[5] scalars,uint256[] ls,uint256[] rs); coords=C_range,A,S,T1,T2 as x,y pairs; scalars=tauX,mu,t,a,b; ls/rs each exactly 12 scalars (six x then six y)
testBoundary: Candidate zero/q/max rejection is tested at the production scalar acceptance predicate, not by finding a Keccak preimage or overriding the production verifier transcript
parametersValidationPlacement: All 130 fixed points are checked off-chain for canonical coordinates, on-curve, nonidentity and pairwise distinct. The constructor checks canonical/on-curve/nonidentity and equality with expectedParametersHash, so an additional O(N^2) duplicate scan is omitted.
